notes.title: Indie classic Super Hexagon gets a big free Neo update out now
notes.content: Super Hexagon, a true indie gem classic from Terry Cavanagh has a big update out now and it has also become Steam Deck Verified with it.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/05/indie-classic-super-hexagon-gets-a-big-free-neo-update-out-now

notes.title: Trading cards, 50% off sale, and a new game coming soon
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Just a quick announcement to let you all know:

 - I have a new game coming out this Summer that I'm really excited about. It's called Dicey Dungeons, and I think it's the best game I've ever worked on. Consider wishlisting if you'd like to get a reminder when it's out!

 - I finally added trading cards to Super Hexagon. Hope you like them! (I've also added some for my other game, VVVVVV).

 - Both Super Hexagon and VVVVVV are currently in a 50% off week-long sale!

Thanks for reading <3

- Terry
